summary: Science Applications International Corp filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Master Accounts Receivable Purchase Agreement with MUFG Bank. The amendment increases the facility limit for selling eligible U.S. government receivables from $300 million to $400 million. No other material terms changed. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. The filing includes the amendment as an exhibit and discloses the enhancement of an off-balance-sheet obligation. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic implications; the event is a standard credit facility amendment.
